$comment: Who owns each kind of piece (CLAUDE.md, 'Nada desenhado à mão quando o kit já tem'). A primitive drawn outside the owners, with one of the words of its domain nearby, is a finding. Words are matched whole, case-insensitive, in the code around the primitive (identifiers split on camelCase and _).

structure.use: every wall as the houses: wallPiece of game-floorplan-three (the houses' structure, drawn by the house renderer) or a whole house; the street pieces of game-urban

furniture.use: the household catalogue (furnitureSpec of game-interactables-three, e.g. dining_table, bookcase, laundry_tub) or game-props3d

people.use: the people of game-characters-people drawn by game-characters-three (createPlayerAvatar, the cast)

plants.use: the species of game-vegetation-species drawn by game-vegetation-three

items.use: the goods catalogue (game-items-goods) drawn by game-items-three (buildItem)

weapons.use: the arsenal of game-weapons and its models in game-weapons-three (projectileModel, the explosives)
